documents.title: Clarification sought from California Software Company Ltd
Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On July 20, 2026

analysis.summary: Management states that Calsoft sharpened its strategic focus in fiscal year 2024-25 on empowering small and microenterprises with artificial intelligence solutions. The company experienced robust user growth, with dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem growing to serve over 1000 merchants and achieving 95% annual client retention. Furthermore, executives highlight that the company invested heavily in AI platforms like dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo, while broader industry trends showed a surge in small business AI adoption. California Software Company Limited focuses on empowering small businesses through innovative technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, and IoT in its Annual Report 2024. Management noted that the company invested all its revenues over the last three years into e-commerce application development, leading to inadequate profits.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: Calsoft's digital ecosystem for dSpeedUp grew to serve over 1000 merchants during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying artificial intelligence effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Calsoft remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.
